lead_raw_text:
The structure of Cs4Rb4Cd2Cl12 (reduced formula Cs2Rb2CdCl6) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4/mmm (No. 38), with 22 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Cd and Cs each in octahedral coordination by six Cl atoms, while Rb centers show a close-packed-like local arrangement with twelve Cl neighbors. Cl environments include a single-neighbor motif and a trigonal-bipyramidal motif with one Cd and four Rb neighbors. Validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-sharing between Cd and Cs octahedra, corner-sharing among Cs octahedra, and face-sharing between Cs octahedra and Rb 12-vertex polyhedra.
